title: Loss of precision in `scalarPrice` function
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as the price will not be very far from the expected one  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it will not always result in big loss of precision  ## Description  In `scalarPrice` there is this code:  ```solidity uint256 b_18 = 1e18; uint256 t_mod = t % (t_r - t); uint256 x = (t + t_mod) * b_18 / t_r; uint256 y = !isInitialised ? state.price : window.price;  return y - (y * x) / b_18; ```  Here, when you calculate `x` you divide by `t_r` even though later you multiply `x` by `y`.
